obituaries.headline: E15R2U…TKTx Steps Back From $STONK, Selling $109K of a Larger Position
obituaries.deck: Sold 306K STONK on Solana for $109K on Thursday evening, taking payment in USDC, and kept $98.8K of the position. Leaves $213K in realized profit over six months, a 42% win rate and a five-token estate worth $863K.
body: On Thursday evening, E15R2U…TKTx, a Solana wallet carried on Nansen's books as “Smart Money”, stepped back from $STONK. It sold 306K tokens in a single transaction for $109K, taking payment in USDC, and holds $98.8K of $STONK still, with no plan for it announced. The sale was the largest of five exits the wallet made that day, $315K in all.

Over the past six months the wallet booked $213K in realized profit across 955 sales of 19 tokens, winning 42% of the time and pressing on regardless. It will be remembered, fittingly, for $STONK, which returned $137K, and for a profitable spell in $GP.
It is survived by five holdings: $USDC ($571K), $GP ($103K), $STONK ($98.8K), $ZCAT ($54.1K) and $CRED ($36.1K). The estate is valued at $863K.
The Smart Money desk notes that the address remains open; retirement, in this trade, is seldom permanent.
